purpose: What the hangar's native code fixes in place, shown locked in Blender so dressing is arranged around it. Nothing here is written back: ASSStation owns the deck, the walls, the docking lane, the docked ship and the service anchors.
units: Unreal centimetres, station-local, Z up, left-handed. The add-on converts on load: metres, Y flipped.
display: WIRE draws edges only; GHOST is a see-through solid in the entry's colour [r, g, b, alpha].

flight_lane.why: A docking ship flies this volume. No part's world bounds may overlap it. Floor panels are the one exception: their visible top belongs at Z -7.25, above the hidden physical floor at Z -10, so a part whose bounds end at or below floor_top_z (plus floor_tolerance) does not count.
source: Scripts/PrepareStationPitStopLayout.py:21 LANE = dict(x=(-1900.0, 1715.0), y=(-700.0, 700.0), z=(-10.0, 967.5)), asserted at :162-167
Source/SpaceSurvival/Private/SSStation.cpp:101-105 CanAssistDocking: |Y| <= 700, Z -10 .. 967.5, wall ends at X -1675
docs/STATION_EDITING.md:119 docking lane guide and the floor panel exception

objects.name: Deck
objects.note: The physical floor: X +-1700, Y +-1400, top at Z -10. Visible floor panels sit on it with their top at Z -7.25.

objects.name: Wall boundaries
objects.note: Solid and invisible in the game. The two mouth halves leave the 1400 cm opening between them.

objects.name: Flight lane
objects.note: The volume parts must not enter: X -1900..1715, |Y| <= 700, Z -10..967.5. Apply refuses a scene with a part in it.

objects.name: Mouth
objects.note: The plane a ship crosses to come in: X -1700, the admission gap |Y| <= 700, between the deck and the bay beams.
source: Source/SpaceSurvival/Private/SSStation.cpp:296-297 the split inbound wall at X -1700 leaves Y -700..700 open
